title: Elizondo saw Jacobs's film at AATIP

tellings.quote: he verified when he was in charge of atip he saw my my film my account

plain: A former Pentagon intelligence officer named Luis Elizondo is said to have confirmed that, while he ran AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, he saw the film and the written account of a man named Robert Jacobs. Michels repeats what Jacobs told him, in Jacobs's words: "he verified when he was in charge of AATIP he saw my film, my account." If true, it would mean Jacobs's material had reached the Pentagon's own study of these reports.
